default.$description: Secondary button fill. BELLA none (outline) · Chip surface (white in light, card grey in dark), Figma-like, 17 Nov.

hover.$description: Secondary and tertiary button fill on hover. BELLA none · Chip light background/subtle (grey) · Chip dark background/highlight (10% white wash; Elleta 18 Nov: “A, card grey”).

active.$description: Secondary and tertiary button fill when pressed. BELLA background/subtle · Chip light background/subtle · Chip dark background/highlight (10% white wash; Elleta 18 Nov: “A, card grey”).

disabled.$description: Disabled button fill. BELLA and Chip light background/subtle (as before) · Chip dark background/surface (card grey, so a disabled button no longer looks heavier than one at rest; Elleta 18 Nov: “A, card grey”).

default.$description: Secondary button edge, 3:1. BELLA and Chip border/strong (grey edge, 17 Nov).

disabled.$description: Secondary button edge when disabled. BELLA and Chip light border/strong (as before) · Chip dark border/default (faint, so disabled reads as off; Elleta 18 Nov: “A, card grey”).

active.$description: Secondary and tertiary label when pressed. BELLA content/brand (ink) · Chip content/default (ink).

current-background.$description: NavList current item fill. BELLA background/brand (dark-ink plate, inverts in dark) · Chip none: the rail and the project tree mark the current item with bold ink only, so "you are here" shows once; light blue stays on Tabs and Segmented control (Elleta, 21 Nov 2026 late, visual study: "ok i approve"). Used by Nav item, Tree item, SectionNav item, PageOutline link, Project panel, Icon rail.

label-color.$description: NavList current item word and icon (icon = label colour). BELLA content/brand-knockout · Chip content/default (bold ink). Part token because BELLA and Chip differ (Elleta, 17 Nov: “ok create both”).

hover-background.$description: Nav item hover fill (NavList, Tree item, SectionNav item, PageOutline link). BELLA background/subtle (as before) · Chip light and dark background/default, the page tone: quieter than the current wash, so hover never looks like current (Elleta 18 Nov: “S2, lighter hover”). 18 Nov: Chip hover is color/background/brand-subtle, the one light-blue hover on every interactive element except buttons (Elleta: “the same for all interactive elements so we dont cofuse users”; replaces the 17 Nov page-tone hover). BELLA unchanged.
